title: Implement registry discovery function
description: Implement discoverThemes() that discovers installed theme packages via node_modules scanning or package.json dependencies. Returns unified theme manifest with metadata. Must work in both Node.js and edge runtime contexts.
acceptance_criteria: discoverThemes() function exported from themes package
Finds all packages matching naming convention
Returns unified theme manifest with metadata
Works in both Node.js and edge runtime contexts

evidence.context: Phase 4 — runtime theme discovery for npm-based registry
